record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:76 — No tests for case sensitivity: existing-attendee and blacklist checks compare raw guest casing against lowercased or stored emails, so mixed-case duplicates or blacklisted guests get through.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the filtering for duplicates/blacklist is case-sensitive: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. However, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is explicitly lowercased while `guest` is not (`.toLowerCase()` is never applied), so a mixed-case input (e.g. `Bad@Example.com`) can bypass the blacklist. Similarly, mixed-case duplicates can slip past the existing-attendee check if stored emails differ only by case. This is a real behavioral defect in the diff, not merely missing tests.
